oldChinese: 默认一页最多消费 5×20=100 个候选；仍不足 20 条就明确 partial=true。
newChinese: 默认一页最多消费 5×20=100 个候选；预算耗尽且仍有后续候选时，未满页才返回 partial=true；确认耗尽可正常返回短页。
oldEnglish: A default page consumes at most 5×20=100 candidates; if still short, return partial=true.
newEnglish: A default page consumes at most 5×20=100 candidates. A short page is partial=true only when the budget is exhausted and more candidates remain; confirmed exhaustion permits a normal short page.

layouts.text: 终图有完整回程。默认一页最多消费 5×20=100 个候选；预算耗尽且仍有后续候选时，未满页才返回 partial=true；确认耗尽可正常返回短页。cursor 指向实际消费到的最后一个候选，不指向预取批次末尾，避免把没处理的有效帖跳过去。

Complete the return. A default page consumes at most 5×20=100 candidates. A short page is partial=true only when the budget is exhausted and more candidates remain; confirmed exhaustion permits a normal short page. The cursor names the last candidate actually consumed, not the end of a prefetched batch, so untouched valid posts are not skipped.
